label: Qualify second source
description: Nominate and qualify an additional vendor (PPAP, source list entry) so the material is no longer single-sourced.

label: Raise safety stock
description: Increase safety stock at the plant to bridge a potential supply interruption.

label: Rebalance quota arrangement
description: Shift quota share away from the at-risk vendor to an existing valid vendor.

label: Supplier development
description: Joint improvement plan with the at-risk supplier (capacity, quality, financial health).

label: Expedite open POs
description: Pull in or expedite open purchase orders with the current supplier.

label: Accept risk (documented)
description: Risk is accepted after review. Requires a justification note.
